writer_actor.operation: replace complete document content and save

solo.definition: Paired actor-specific controls: each actor runs alone on its own clean Guest; the other application remains seeded and must remain unchanged.

ma_id.definition: Both independent actors run on separate OSWorld Guest desktops with separate focus and input state.

ma_sd.definition: Both independent actors run on the same Guest, X11 desktop, Writer/Calc windows, keyboard, and pointer.

expected_interference.mechanism: Calc activates after Writer's first observation; Writer resumes without reacquiring focus, so its replacement keystrokes can enter Calc.
expected_interference.deterministic_trigger: shared desktop focus transfer under the frozen naive schedule

evaluator.oracle: saved Flat ODF XML exact comparison

reset.oracle: new Guest container identity and both seeded file paths absent before task initialization
